general_information.Syllabus Name: Exhibition Display & Event Design_Thiết kế cho sự kiện và triển lãm
general_information.Description: In this course, students will learn to design and produce exhibitions for museums, galleries, libraries, private businesses, specialist trade events and conferences, and large commercial public events. …The focus of this course examines the role that exhibitions and events play in communicating knowledge and explores the variety of display methods within the language of exhibits.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination 2. Actively participate in class activities 3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 5. Read the textbook in advance 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. 7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submlit to the teacher 01 day after the course.

description: In this course, students will learn to design and produce exhibitions for museums, galleries, libraries, private businesses, specialist trade events and conferences, and large commercial public events. …The focus of this course examines the role that exhibitions and events play in communicating knowledge and explores the variety of display methods within the language of exhibits.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the way people communicate visually and communication design organizes experience in variety of structures. Denotation and connotation are two levels of meaning we assign to messages.

Understand the concept of The ideal brief and the types of information that may be included. Describe and analyze The visitors and targeted audiences. Analyze The site: opportunities and constraints, their impact on design strategies.
Plan an exhibition strategy based on the brief. Devising a major path for visitors.
Describes how the exhibition strategy by sketches, models and computer visuals are then used to develop the final design plan
Using the right and appropriate graphic elements in each practical space. Ensure legibility of text and images on large-format printing and production issues
Apply interactive techniques, both digital and non-digital, can be used to stimulate visitor involvement in an exhibition.
Responsibility to use skills, positive attitude and a professional working style
Skills in proficient in presentation and teamwork skills.
